title: Rack It Up: Twilight Forest
description: A Twilight Forest compat addon for Rack It Up
body:
A Twilight Forest compat addon for Rack It Up that adds meef and venison jerky with their own drying recipes in addition to more variants for the drying rack itself based on the different wood variants from the Twilight Forest.

![Racks and Jerky](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/M5B3FQIl/images/02405dacd8c099bc7e4e6f72cb7fe56a9cb07741.png)
